business.description: Atharv Enterprises Limited is a textile company aiming to establish itself as one of the most trusted and leading textile companies in the Indian market with a commitment to quality, customer satisfaction, innovation, and timely execution.

outlook.statement: Focus will remain on strengthening market presence, enhancing operational efficiencies, embracing innovation and creating long-term value for shareholders and other stakeholders.
All said and done, there are good reasons to believe that Atharv Enterprises Limited will perform even better in FY 2026. We hope that this forward-looking statement turns out to be true.

The Independent Directors are also regularly briefed on the nature of the Textile Industry as a whole, nature and scope of the activities of the Company, Competition prevailing therein and the Company's future forward looking plans with briefing on future prospect of the Company.

risks: External environment remains uncertain and challenging. Cotton MSP hikes, tariff re-escalations, and global recessionary trends could erode competitiveness.
Tariff Volatility: US tariffs swung from 50% (temporary in 2025) to 18% (current); future uncertainty remains with Section 122 authority expiring in July 2026.
Cotton MSP Premium: Indian cotton priced 5–7 cents/lb above global benchmarks, compressing margins across spinning and garmenting.
Global Demand Weakness: Recovery in consumption remains uneven, especially in Western markets, limiting export growth.
Competition: Bangladesh and Vietnam remain cost-competitive; if Bangladesh stabilises, diverted orders may return.
Compliance & ESG Pressures: Increasing buyer focus on sustainability, labour standards, and speed to market requires investment in systems and certifications
Risk Management - Business risk evaluation and management is an ongoing process within the Company. The assessment is periodically examined by the Board.
